description.zh: 策略训练的是面对一个目标和若干可选行动时，如何权衡收益与代价、规划步骤顺序、分配有限资源、预测对方或环境的反应并据此调整选择的思维动作。它不考察某个学科知识，考察的是「给定目标和可选行动，能不能选出让结果更好的那一个，并在多步/多方博弈中持续调整」。
description.en: Strategy trains the move of weighing benefit against cost, planning a step order, allocating limited resources, and predicting an opponent's or environment's reaction in order to adjust a choice — given a goal and a set of available actions. It does not assess subject knowledge; it assesses whether the better option can be chosen given a goal and available actions, and whether the choice can be adjusted across multiple steps or an interactive game.

ageRange.noteZh: 覆盖 4-5 岁到小学二年级。阶段一沿用已有 6 个文字单元（G1-G2）并新增 2 个 K1/K2 图形单元；更丰富的交互式策略题型（真正的拖拽排序、资源分配、多方博弈模拟）留待阶段二，详见下方 deferredRoadmap。
ageRange.noteEn: Covers ages 4-5 through grade 2. Stage one reuses the 6 existing text units (G1-G2) and adds 2 new K1/K2 picture units; richer interactive strategy item types (true drag-to-sequence, resource allocation, multi-party game simulation) are deferred to a later stage — see deferredRoadmap below.

educationReference.policyZh: 以全球基础教育大纲和教材为知识背景，不增加额外知识负担，以知识内容承载思维训练。策略训练刻意区别于单纯的知识记忆：题目考察的是能否从目标出发选出更优行动，而不是背诵结论。
educationReference.policyEn: Uses global K-12 foundational curricula as background knowledge without adding extra knowledge burden; domain content is used as a carrier for thinking training. Strategy training is deliberately distinct from rote recall: items assess whether a better action can be chosen given a goal, not whether a fact is memorized.

seriesBoundary.zh: 与 Logic/Comparison/Pattern/Modeling 的边界：Logic 训练「条件→推理→结论」，判断什么是真的；Comparison 训练在已知两个量的前提下判断关系；Pattern 训练「下一个是什么」的续写预测；Modeling 训练把情境转换成结构。本模块训练的是「目标→当前状态→可选行动→选择→结果→调整」，核心是收益/代价的权衡和多步/多方情境下的持续调整，不是单纯判断真假或续写规律。
seriesBoundary.en: Boundary with Logic/Comparison/Pattern/Modeling: Logic trains "condition -> inference -> conclusion", judging what is true; Comparison trains judging a relation given two already-known quantities; Pattern trains continuing/predicting what comes next; Modeling trains turning a situation into a structure. This module trains "goal -> current state -> available actions -> choice -> outcome -> adjustment" — the core skill is weighing benefit against cost and adjusting across multiple steps or parties, not judging truth or continuing a pattern.

rootGeneScopeNote.zh: 本模块沿用单一既有基因 RG.STRATEGY.DECISION.PLANNING，不按候选类型拆分成 8 条细粒度基因。原因：rootgene.json 中 STRATEGY 分类目前只有这一条基因，且已被 learning-math-strategy 使用；拆分新基因是需要谨慎处理边界文本的架构决策，属于本轮范围外，留待后续阶段评估。
rootGeneScopeNote.en: This module reuses the single pre-existing gene RG.STRATEGY.DECISION.PLANNING rather than splitting into 8 fine-grained per-type genes. Reason: the STRATEGY category in rootgene.json currently has only this one gene, already used by learning-math-strategy; splitting genes is an architectural decision requiring careful boundary-text work, out of scope for this round, deferred to a later stage.

geneReporting.zh: 上报以单元（一次训练）为单位：无论单元内出现哪种策略类型，都上报同一条 RG.STRATEGY.DECISION.PLANNING，不做题型区分。
geneReporting.en: Reporting happens per finished unit: regardless of which strategy type appears in the unit, the same RG.STRATEGY.DECISION.PLANNING gene is reported, with no per-type distinction.

examples: picking the option that best reaches a stated goal (most candy, driest walk)
given a goal and shuffled steps, picking the order that reaches it
choosing how to split a limited resource across needs so the outcome is best
predicting the outcome two or more steps ahead before choosing
choosing the action that wins against a simple fixed-rule opponent
combining several strategy considerations (cost, goal, order) into one choice
navigating a grid/maze from start to goal under movement constraints
typeTree.notesZh: 需要网格/地图状态和逐步移动判定，依赖 deferredRoadmap 中提出的新 Runtime（Plan/Simulate）和状态机接口，本轮不实现。
typeTree.notesEn: Requires grid/map state and step-by-step move validation, depending on the new Runtimes (Plan/Simulate) and state-machine interface proposed in deferredRoadmap; not implemented this round.

examples: satisfying multiple simultaneous constraints while optimizing an outcome
typeTree.notesZh: 真正的约束求解版本需要 deferredRoadmap 中的扩展 Template schema（constraints/scoreRule/optimalSolution），本轮以 resource_allocation/adaptation_optimization 的简化选择题形式承载，不做真正的约束求解。
typeTree.notesEn: A true constraint-solving version needs the extended Template schema (constraints/scoreRule/optimalSolution) in deferredRoadmap; this round carries a simplified multiple-choice form of it under resource_allocation/adaptation_optimization instead of real constraint solving.

deferredRoadmap.zh: 已落地：状态/动作引擎（generator.js 中的 ST_ENGINE，含 BFS 最优解）；K1–G2 生成式题目，含可操作的互动题（点顺序、挑着买、按按钮变数、和电脑轮流取饼干）与「他说得对吗」检查题；4 档反馈（best/better/good/valid）按完成效率分级，完成即通过，最优多一个 ⭐，各档次数与重来次数写入报告 process（不改 shell）。仍未做：拖拽排序 Runtime、完整 Template schema（goal/initialState/actions/transitionRules 等，目前每种题型自带生成器）、开放式说理题；棋类各自独立，不在本模块。
deferredRoadmap.en: Done: a state/action engine (ST_ENGINE in generator.js, with a BFS optimal solver); generated K1-G2 questions including playable ones (tap the order, fill the basket, press the buttons, take-turns cookie game against the computer) and "is he right?" checking questions; 4 feedback tiers (best/better/good/valid) graded by efficiency - finishing passes, optimal earns a star, tier counts and restarts go into the report process (no shell change). Not done: a drag-sort runtime, the full template schema (goal/initialState/actions/transitionRules...; each question type has its own generator today), open-ended explain questions; board games are separate and out of scope here.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 在小地图上比较三条路线：数垫脚石比长短，排除有陷阱过不去的，选出走得通又最近的一条。
levelMap.objectiveEn: Compare three routes on a small map: count stones, rule out routes with traps, and pick the shortest one that works.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 按规则排出先后顺序；两样东西都要拿时比较不同走法的总步数；既要拿到东西又不能超过限定步数。
levelMap.objectiveEn: Order stops by stated rules; compare the total steps of different ways to pick up two items; get an item without going over a step limit.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 在金币、能量有限的条件下做计算和安排：买得多又不超预算，安排走法顺序让能量不降到 0，先拿钥匙再开门并比较总步数。
levelMap.objectiveEn: Plan with limited coins and energy: buy the most without going over, order stretches so energy never drops below 0, and fetch the key before the door while comparing total steps.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 多步预测与优化：和聪明的对手轮流取数并保证赢，用最少的按键次数变出目标数，在预算内两种都买且个数最多，安排顺序让有上限的能量剩得最多。
levelMap.objectiveEn: Multi-step look-ahead and optimisation: win a take-turns game against a smart rival, reach a target with the fewest presses, buy both kinds within a budget for the most items, and order steps so capped energy ends highest.

statistics.note: Phase one uploads only the summary Attempt; no round-level telemetry is declared yet since the puzzle mode has no sub-round structure.
